mapper.insert: insert into coupon(name, description, stock, status, start_time, end_time, limit_per_user, create_time, update_time) values (#{name}, #{description}, #{stock}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{limitPerUser}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select id, name, description, stock, status, start_time, end_time, limit_per_user from coupon where status = 1 order by id desc
